Tips for salads
•
Go for fresh vegetables and fruit
•
Go easy on “extras” that add unwanted calories, fat,
and sodium
•
Put dressings on the side.  Even “lite” and “free” dress-
ings add up.
SALAD FIXINGS
A variety of vegetables makes for a nutrient-packed low-calorie
lunch.  Remember to have the dressing served “on-the-side.”
